The goals for today are to understand hardware vocabulary, to identify and use acronyms, especially computer science acronyms.
And to be able to explain hardware components of your computer.
Let's look at this idea of acronyms.
Computer science uses many acronyms.
Here is a simple definition.
An acronym is a word formed from the first letters of other words in a phrase.
Acronyms are often pronounced as a separate word.
For example, the phrase unidentified flying object is often shortened to the acronym.
UFO.
People often just use the acronym instead of saying the whole phrase.
Maybe you knew the acronym UFO, but you didn't know that it stands for The phrase unidentified flying object.
Acronyms are very useful when you talk to other computer scientists.
Many technical terms are usually Very long.
So, when you use acronyms, you can speak quickly.
For example, the socket that you connect the GPU to on the motherboard is called the peripheral component interconnect express.
This is a very long phrase.
When you're speaking quickly about hardware, you can just use the acronym PCIE.
Some acronyms are said like a word instead of just saying the letters.
For example, the North Atlantic Treaty Organization is called.
Called NATO.
It is not spelled out N-A-T-O, but said like a word, NATO.
NATO.
Here's an example from computer science.
In your computer, the stick of hardware that holds the memory is called the dual inline memory module.
But we just say DIM for short.
Whatever language you speak, many English acronyms are used when talking about computer science.
So it is a good idea to learn the acronyms and their full phrasal meanings.
Let's look at some acronyms that are commonly used when talking about hardware.
CPU stands for Central Processing Unit.
The CPU is the main processor that performs calculations and controls most operations in the computer.
DIM stands for For dual inline memory module.
The DIM is the hardware that stores and processes the computer's temporary memory.
GPU stands for Graphics Processing Unit.
The GPU is a specialized processor that creates images, video, and 3D graphics for a computer.
OS stands for operating system.
An operating system is the main software that manages hardware.
And allows users to run programs.
PCIE stands for Peripheral Component Interconnect Express.
PCIE is a high speed interface used to connect devices such as GPUs and SSDs to the motherboard.
PSU Stands for Power Supply Unit.
The PSU converts electricity from a wall outlet into the correct power for computer components.
RAM stands for random access memory.
Random access memory, or RAM, is temporary working memory where a computer stores data.
That programs are currently using.
SSD stands for solid state drive.
An SSD is a storage.
Device that uses flash memory to store data quickly without any moving parts.
There are many more acronyms that we use in computer.
Computer science.
